idea-plugin.name: IDEContextForCodex
idea-plugin.description:
IDEContextForCodex gives Codex access to relevant editor context in JetBrains IDEs.

When requested, it can provide the active file, selected text, and open editor tabs.

The plugin reads only the editor state needed for a request. It does not save files automatically or collect environment variables, terminal content, run configurations, diagnostics, or version-control data.
